thread:
Maya R: Heads up — prod-ml nodes failing to finish bootstrap, lots of 403s pulling model artifacts and secrets.
Raj: seeing same. started ~08:03 UTC after the vault rotation window.
Carlos: logs?
Maya R: paste of agent log:
```
2026-03-23T08:03:12Z agent bootstrap error: fetch secret failed
http status=403 url=https://vault.prod.internal/v1/secret/data/prod/agent-token
vault: access denied: policy "restrictive-rotation-2026-03-23"
```
Ben P: I rolled the rotation at 08:00, the new policy tightened namespace mapping to "infra/agents/*" which should be fine but looks like the artifact service role wasn't in the allowlist.
Steve (security): we scoped the rotation to reduce blast radius — I may have missed the artifact role mapping. sorry. :grimacing:
Raj: tl;dr nodes can't decrypt model blobs because they rely on vault tokens fetched during init, so they don't join GPU pool. autoscaler keeps triggering cross-region spinups -> unexpected on-demand cost in us-west-2.
Maya R: ops-bot alerted cost watch at 08:20, +120% GPU spend hour-over-hour.
Carlos: can we short-circuit new nodes to use cached model on disk? maybe a workaround to get some capacity.
Ben P: temp fix: create a legacy role that mirrors previous permissions and bind to artifact-service. running:
```
vault policy write prod-agent-legacy - <<EOF
path "secret/data/prod/agent-token" {
  capabilities = ["read"]
}
EOF
vault token create -policy=prod-agent-legacy -orphan -ttl=1h
```
Maya R: that would let bootstraps succeed while we fix policy mapping. please run in prod-safe mode and log it.
Steve (security): I'll open an emergency exception and patch the rotation plan. we also disabled the audit-shipper during the rotation, iirc — that means we don't have full audit trails for the outage window. need to restore immediately for compliance.
Raj: urgent: re-enable audit exporter -> s3. how do we do that quickly?
Carlos: command to re-enable:
```
kubectl -n infra patch deployment audit-exporter -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"exporter","env":[{"name":"EXPORTER_ENABLED","value":"true"}]}]}}}}'
```
Ben P: done the legacy policy and token creation (audit: ran with dry-run flag then applied). nodes are starting to pull now. watching.
Maya R: seeing some nodes join, warm pools filling slowly. cost alert still active but trending down.
Steve (security): I'll file a post-rotation review and coordinate with compliance to document the audit gap and the emergency exception. thanks for quick triage :heart: 
Raj: follow-ups: (1) update rotation playbook to include artifact role smoke test, (2) add automated policy diff check before apply, (3) make audit-shipper toggles guarded by runbook approval.
Maya R: agreed. creating a follow-up ticket and will add owners. closing on this thread once costs stabilize.
ops-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-0312-VAULT-ROTATE. linked to ticket PLT-5021.
